fake_token_approved.meaning: attacker has deployed fakeToken and approved the Distributor to spend it

claim_rewards_reverts.checkpoint: after addRewards with mismatched token pair

quote_claims_blocked.meaning: per-pool permanent DoS of real quote reward claims persists until migration/upgrade
quote_claims_blocked.checkpoint: after addRewards with mismatched token pair

assumptions: addRewards is callable by the attacker with an arbitrary token1 argument (permissionless or otherwise reachable).
The fakeToken transferFrom succeeds given the attacker's approval.
The pool's established quote asset is rs.quoteAsset and users have positive pending quote rewards.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether addRewards is permissionless beyond the attacker calling it; 'anyone' appears only in the title.
Exact value of X and whether fakeToken transferFrom succeeds is not specified beyond attacker approval.
Whether the DoS is truly permanent versus until migration/upgrade is qualified in the report.

limitations: Formalizes only the per_pool_dos impact; inconsistent_accounting and claim_reverts are handled in separate passes.
The DoS permanence is qualified as 'until a migration/upgrade' and encoded as a Boolean observable rather than a temporal bound.
No numeric definition of X or pending reward amounts is given; the claim-blocked outcome is represented as a grounded Boolean.
